name: ember-terminals
description: Integrated terminals and debuggees that live in ember node, not in the window: they keep running when every window is closed and reappear on any device.

untrustedWorkspaces.description: Starts processes on the workspace's computer.

commands.title: Use Persistent Terminals for New Terminals and Tasks
Re-attach Debugger to a Running Debuggee…

ember.terminals.proxyUrl.description: Base URL of the DarkPyonix proxy that relays /__terms to ember node. Empty: the origin this window was loaded from.

ember.terminals.device.description: Name shown to other devices ("controlled by <device>"). Empty: derived from the browser.

ember.terminals.autoAttach.description: Show this project's running persistent terminals (started from VS Code on any device) in this window, also ones started later elsewhere.

ember.terminals.killOnClose.description: Closing a terminal with the trash icon kills its session (as with ordinary terminals). Closing or reloading the window never does.

ember.terminals.emberTermPath.description: Absolute path of the ember-term binary on the workspace's computer, used by the setup command for tasks (terminal.integrated.automationProfile.*).

ember.debug.persistent.markdownDescription: Run debuggees of `launch` configurations with `"console": "integratedTerminal"` (types `node`/`pwa-node` and `debugpy`/`python`) in persistent sessions: the program keeps running when the window closes, and the debugger attaches to it over 127.0.0.1. Opt out per configuration with `"emberPersistent": false`.

enumDescriptions: Ask whether to stop a debuggee that still runs after its debug session ended in this window.
Stop it (closing or reloading the window never does).
ember.debug.onStop.description: What to do with a persistent debuggee when its debug session is stopped in this window.

ember.debug.offerReattach.description: Offer to re-attach the debugger to this project's debuggees that are still running from an earlier window or another device.

ember.debug.debugpyPath.description: Directory containing the debugpy package on the workspace computer (e.g. the Python Debugger extension's bundled/libs). Empty: debugpy must be importable by the configuration's interpreter (pip install debugpy).
